remarks: Escape to North Stamford! Updated ranch on quiet, level and beautifully treed 2.5 acre lot. Contemporary features such as vaulted ceilings, skylights, picture windows and glass sliders bring light and scenic beauty indoors. Updated kitchen has gorgeous granite counters and stainless appliances. The majestic fireplace hearth, the radiant heat in the floors for winter and the central air conditioning for summer make this home a cozy and comfortable retreat from hustle and bustle of easily-accessed downtown Stamford. Did i mention the recently-renovated, accessory dwelling?. Tenant currently in place. This spacious one bed and one bath apartment offsets the mortgage considerably. This is a rare opportunity for a first time homebuyer, downsizers or anyone looking for quiet peaceful one level living with income earning potential .
